# M22-S6: the Sec 11 end-to-end example ejects to pure Go and prints the same
# output. test/logos/example/order_service.lgo is the single source: a fake
# database, a closed union, a property interface, a const map, options, errdefer,
# go group, Locked and Hot, and a leading-dot chain. order_service.out is the
# expected output of the native build and of the ejected tree.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/example/order_service.lgo m/order_service.lgo
cd m

# The native build prints the expected output file.
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/example/order_service.out
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

# Snapshot the source tree; eject must never write into it.
cp order_service.lgo $WORK/order_service.lgo.orig
cp go.mod $WORK/go.mod.orig

# Eject the module: plain .go name, no loGo/s source, one support module.
logos eject -o out
exists out/order_service.go
exists out/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/go.mod
exists out/_logos_deps/rt/sync/sync.go
! exists out/order_service.lgo
! grep '^//go:build !logos' out/order_service.go

# The ejected tree runs under plain go with identical output.
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/example/order_service.out

# The ejected tree is vet- and gofmt-clean.
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

# The source tree is unchanged after the eject.
cmp order_service.lgo $WORK/order_service.lgo.orig
cmp go.mod $WORK/go.mod.orig

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/order

go 1.27
